repos.name: wow_launcher
repos.description: An unofficial, classic-styled World of Warcraft launcher for managing multiple clients, addons, news, playtime, updates, and game installations from one place.

repos.name: airportnetworkgraphalgorithms
repos.description: A C++ graph algorithms project that models an airport and flight network as a weighted directed graph. The program analyzes flight routes using distance and cost data and provides several graph-based operations.

release.name: v.1.0.1
release.body:
Changes Made:

- Added MacOS and Linux support
- Fixed bugs in Windows version

- NOTE: CURRENTLY I DO NOT HAVE A DEVELOPER ACCOUNT WITH APPLE, SO IT WILL GIVE A WARNING ABOUT OPENING IT. This is safe and if you go to settings, then Privacy and Security, then Open, it will still work. If you do not feel safe using it this way, you can build it yourself.
